mapper.select: SELECT u.username AS username, j.judger_description AS description, j.judger_language_ids AS languageIds, j.judger_is_ready AS isReady, j.judger_cpu_load AS cpuLoad, j.judger_memory_usage AS memoryUsage, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, j.judger_start_time, NOW()) * 1000 AS uptime FROM voj_judgers j JOIN voj_users u ON u.uid = j.judger_uid WHERE j.judger_heartbeat_time > NOW() - INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND ORDER BY u.username
SELECT judger_language_ids FROM voj_judgers WHERE judger_is_ready = 1 AND judger_heartbeat_time > NOW() - INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND
